MALAYSIAN AVIATION COMMISSION ACT 2015

MALAYSIAN AVIATION COMMISSION (AVIATION SERVICES CHARGES)
REGULATIONS 2016

IN exercise of the powers conferred by  section 46 and subsection 98(1) of the Malaysian
Aviation Commission Act 2015 [Act 771], the Commission makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Malaysian Aviation Commission
(Aviation Services Charges) Regulations 2016.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 15 April 2016.

Application
2. These Regulations shall apply to an aerodrome operator.

Interpretation
3. In these Regulations, unless the context otherwise requires—

"parking" or " parked", in relation to an aircraft, means parking or parked at an
aerodrome in the open;

 "housing" or "housed", in relation to an aircraft, means an accommodation in a
hangar or accommodated in a hangar managed and operated by the Director General of
Civil Aviation or an aerodrome operator;

 "aerodrome operator" means a person who holds  an aerodrome operator licence
issued by the Commission  or any person authorized to operate an  aerodrome under the
Act;

"movement" means the landing or take-off of an aircraft.

Landing charges
4.  (1) A landing charge  in respect of each landing of an aircraft at an aerodrome
shall be as specified in the First Schedule.

 (2) The charges under this regulation  shall not apply to the following classes of
aircraft:

(a) any official aircraft of the Federal Government or Government of any
state in Malaysia, including a military aircraft;

(b) any official aircraft of Heads of State, Ministers and other dignitaries
visiting Malaysia as state guests on the basis of reciprocity;

(c) any aircraft engaged in search and rescue operations;

(d) any aircraft which is required to return to the airport of departure or
to an alternate airport due to circumstances beyond the control of the
operator such as malfunctioning of the aircraft equipment or closure
of the destination airport after the departure of the aircraft;

(e) any aircraft engaged in a test flight provided that—

(i) such flight terminates at the airport of departure and is
undertaken solely for the purpose of testing the aircraft or its
instruments; and

(ii) before the flight, the operator of the aircraft has notified the
aerodrome operator of the intended flight and shall satisfy the
aerodrome operator of the genuineness of, and the need for,
the flight; or

(f) such other aircraft or classes of aircrafts as the Commission may
approve.

Additional charges for landing outside notified aerodrome hours of operation
5. (1)  An additional charge equivalent to one half of the landing charge  payable in
accordance with the First Schedule but  subject to a minimum charge of one hundred and
fifty ringgit, shall be payable—

(a) in respect of any landing, except in an emergency, outside the notified
aerodrome hours of operation; or

(b) in respect of any take -off outside the notified aerodrome hours of
operation other than a take -off within one hour of landing outside
such notified aerodrome hours of operation.

 (2)  No movement shall take place outside the notified aerodrome hours of
operation except in an emergency or by prior arrangement with the Director General of
Civil Aviation and the aerodrome operator, as the case may be.

 (3)  In the event of a cancellation of a proposed movement outside the notified
aerodrome hours of operation, the additional charges provided in subregulation (1) shall
be payable unless notice of the cancellation is received by the Director General of Civil
Aviation and the aerodrome operator , as the case may be, not less than two hours before
the notified closing time of the hours of operation.

 (4)  In the event that an airport has been requested to be available for use as an
alternate outside its hours of operation , a charge equivalent to twenty -five per centum of
the landing charge payable in accordance with the First Schedule, but subject to a minimum
charge of one hundred and fifty ringgit , shall be payable  for every three hours or part of
every three hours during which such airport is made available for this purpose.

 (5) For the purpose of this regulation, the hours outside the aerodrome hours of
operation is determined by the Director General of Civil Aviation.

Passenger service charges and security charges
6.  (1) Charges in respect of any person boarding an aircraft carrying passengers for
hire or reward shall be as follows:

(a) passenger service charges as specified in the Second Schedule; and

(b) security charges as specified in the Third Schedule.

 (2) The charges under subregulation (1) shall not apply in the case of—

(a) a passenger in direct transit, that is, proceeding on the same flight or
who is not cleared to  leave the airport area authoriz ed for use of
transit passengers, or who has been involuntarily delayed to  be
transferred to the next available service to his next point of
disembarkation, due to weather or aircraft unserviceability;

(b) the crew of the aircraft;

(c) an infant below the age of two years;

(d) Heads of State , Ministers  and other dignitaries visiting Malaysia  as
state guests; or

(e) such airport s and in respect of such other person or persons as the
Commission may from time to time specify.

Airport pass charges
7. (1)   The charge for the issuance of an airport pass  by the Chief of Security under
the Civil Aviation (Aerodrome Operations) Regulations 2016 [ P.U. (A) 98/2016] shall be as
specified in the Fourth Schedule.

 (2) The charge for the replacement of a lost airport pass shall be as specified in
the Fifth Schedule.

Airside vehicle permit charges
8. (1) The charge for the issuance of an airside vehicle permit  by an aerodrome
operator under the Civil Aviation (Aerodrome Operations) Regulations 2016 shall be as
specified in the Sixth Schedule.

 (2) A proportionate amount of the charge paid may be refund ed if it is proved
that the vehicle has not been or will not be used in the maneuvering area in respect of any
period of not less than three months.

Airside driving permit charges
9.  The charge for the issuance of an airfield driving  permit by an aerodrome operator
under the Civil Aviation (Aerodrome Operations) Regulations 2016 shall be as specified in
the Seventh Schedule.

Security service charges
10. (1) Subject to any agreement on charges and arrangements entered into
between a person, aviation service provider or an organization and an aerodrome operator
for the permission of security services between the time of arrival and the time of
departure of an ai rcraft or in respect of vehicles, buildings, equipment or installations
located within the boundaries of an airport, the charges per hour as specified in the Eighth
Schedule shall be payable  for the assignment of such security personnel as may be
considered by an aerodrome operator or as may be requested by a person, aviation service
provider, or organization.

 (2) For the purpose of subregulation (1), the minimum period of time applicable
for the provision of such services shall be two hours.

Housing and parking charges
11. (1) The housing and parking charges of an aircraft shall be as specified in the
Ninth Schedule.

 (2) The parking time of an aircraft shall be from the time of landing until the
time of take-off.

 (3)  The charges under subregulation (1) shall not be imposed for the first three
hours of parking and shall not apply to the following classes of aircraft:

(a) any official aircraft of the Federal Government or Government of any
state in Malaysia, including military aircraft;

(b) any aircraft engaged in search and rescue operations;

(c) any aircraft which are parked or housed in any hangars owned and
operated by the Director General of Civil Aviation; and

(d) any official aircraft of Heads of State, Ministers and other dignitaries
visiting Malaysia as state guests on the basis of reciprocity for visits
up to a period of forty-eight hours.
